README.md:83:We recommend using https://ddev.com for development.
README.md:85:### Installation (with ddev)
README.md:89:  * `ddev composer install`
README.md:91:  * `ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config`
README.md:97:* Start project `ddev start`
README.md:98:* Run composer commands `ddev composer COMMAND` e.g. `ddev composer install`
README.md:99:* Run drush commands `ddev drush COMMAND` e.g. `ddev drush uli`
README.md:100:* Import latest database snapshot `ddev dbimport`
README.md:102:More information about ddev cli command https://ddev.readthedocs.io/en/stable/users/basics/cli-usage/.
README.md:109:ddev composer patches-relock   # Re-discover patches in composer.json and rewrite patches.lock.json
README.md:110:ddev composer patches-repatch  # Delete, re-download and re-apply patches for all affected packages
README.md:111:ddev composer patches-doctor   # Diagnose common patching issues
README.md:119:ddev composer run php:lint        # PHP parallel lint
README.md:120:ddev composer run php:cs          # PHPCS
README.md:121:ddev composer run php:cs-fix      # Auto-fix PHPCS issues
README.md:122:ddev composer run php:phpstan     # Static analysis
README.md:123:ddev composer run php:rector      # Rector dry-run
README.md:124:ddev composer run php:rector-fix  # Rector auto-fix
README.md:132:ddev exec npm run lint:js         # ESLint JavaScript (entire project)
README.md:133:ddev exec npm run lint:yaml       # ESLint YAML
README.md:134:ddev exec npm run lint:css        # stylelint CSS (profile/modules)
README.md:135:ddev exec npm run lint:css:fix    # Auto-fix CSS
README.md:136:ddev exec npm run lint:scss       # stylelint SCSS (openculturas_base theme)
README.md:137:ddev exec npm run lint:scss:fix   # Auto-fix SCSS
README.md:138:ddev exec npm run prettier        # Prettier JavaScript
README.md:139:ddev exec npm run prettier:css    # Prettier CSS
README.md:140:ddev exec npm run prettier:scss   # Prettier SCSS
README.md:146:ddev exec npx eslint --ext .js --no-ignore path/to/file.js
README.md:155:After that, enable config_devel and run `ddev composer run cde` or `ddev drush cde module`.
README.md:172:`ddev composer run info_file_normalizer`
